description: Integrate voting into existing views: (1) add Audience Voting link + Toggle Voting button to show.xian admin and organizer More dropdowns + voting status badge on hero, (2) add People's Choice section to results.xian + update resultsPage controller to pass votesByContestant. Independent of FEAT-001 in terms of file edits, but logically depends on FEAT-001 routes existing so the links work.
steps:
1. Edit views/events/show.xian — voting status badge in hero: in the hero card's
, after the existing event.status badge ( {{event.status}}), add a second badge: {{#if event.votingOpen}}♥ Voting Open{{else}}Voting Off{{/if}}

2. Edit views/events/show.xian — admin-more-content div (around line 1031-1046): add two items before the divider that precedes the Delete Event button. Item 1 (link): . Item 2 (form):
. Use a ♥ heart SVG (viewBox 0 0 24 24, path d='M20.84 4.61a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.78 0L12 5.67l-1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.78 7.78l1.06 1.06L12 21.23l7.78-7.78 1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-7.78z') for Audience Voting icon.

3. Edit views/events/show.xian — org-more-content div (around line 1047-1059): add the same two items (Audience Voting link + Toggle Voting form) in the same position (before the Delete Event divider). Use identical markup to the admin section.

4. Edit controllers/scoringController.js — resultsPage function: add a 4th parallel fetch inside the existing Promise.all: getDocs(collection(db, 'events', eventId, 'votes')). Assign to vSnap. After the existing const allScores line, add: const allVotes = vSnap.docs.map(d => d.data()); then build: const votesByContestant = {}; allVotes.forEach(v => { if (v.contestantId) votesByContestant[v.contestantId] = (votesByContestant[v.contestantId] || 0) + 1; }); const totalAudienceVotes = allVotes.length;. Then pass votesByContestant and totalAudienceVotes to res.render.

5. Edit views/scoring/results.xian — add the People's Choice section after the '── Judge Scoring Progress ──' section and before the '── Per-Judge Breakdown ──' section (around line 538). The section uses class='section-card animate-fadeup-2 no-print'. Header: 'People's Choice — Audience Vote' with heart SVG icon and badge showing total vote count. Body: for each contestant in ranked order, show a row with: contestant number badge, name, vote count bar (width = votesByContestant[id] / totalAudienceVotes * 100 if totalAudienceVotes > 0 else 0), and vote count number. Use {{#each ranked}} and look up {{lookup ../votesByContestant id}} to get each contestant's vote count. Label clearly 'Audience Vote' in a sub-badge.

6. Register a new Handlebars helper 'lookup' in index.js if not already registered: hbs.registerHelper('lookup', (obj, key) => obj && obj[key] !== undefined ? obj[key] : 0);. Check index.js around line ~90 where helpers are registered — add it there.
acceptance_criteria: node --check views/events/show.xian — file is valid (node won't check Handlebars; use node --check only on .js files; manual review of template syntax is the check here)
show.xian displays voting status badge (green 'Voting Open' or gray 'Voting Off') in the hero card
admin More dropdown in show.xian contains 'Audience Voting' link and 'Open Voting'/'Close Voting' toggle button
organizer More dropdown in show.xian contains the same two items
results.xian People's Choice section is visible and shows per-contestant audience vote bars
resultsPage controller passes votesByContestant and totalAudienceVotes without breaking existing ranked results
verification: node index.js (start server, navigate to /events/:eventId as admin, confirm More dropdown shows Audience Voting + voting toggle, confirm voting badge on hero)
Navigate to /events/:eventId/results and confirm People's Choice section renders below Judge Scoring Progress
findings: All 6 steps implemented. Hero badge added after event.status span. Audience Voting link and Open/Close Voting toggle form inserted before the delete-event divider in both admin-more-content and org-more-content dropdowns. resultsPage Promise.all extended to 5 fetches (added votes subcollection), votesByContestant map built, totalAudienceVotes computed, audienceVoteCount and audienceVotePct attached to each ranked contestant, both passed to res.render. lookup helper registered in index.js. People's Choice section inserted in results.xian between Judge Scoring Progress and Per-Judge Breakdown. node --check passes on both scoringController.js and index.js.
